Please take a moment
Travelers: companion animal travel notice

Please review your pet travel plans before you arrive at Aurelia Skyways. Our Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help you prepare calmly and avoid last-minute delays. Safety takes priority over speed on every journey, and the senior coordinator reviews daily service needs. <<FACT F030>> Please keep documents, carriers, and comfort items ready for check-in. 

Aurelia Skyways asks travelers to follow staff guidance, keep pets secure, and allow extra room for loading and screening. <<FACT F019>> If you are traveling with a pet such as Moose, please confirm your arrangements early and bring what your animal needs for a steady trip. 

For help with forms, pet handling, and arrival guidance, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
